decisions.reason: Visibility rose from a mention in 2023 to its own page in 2024, which signals growing commitment to an authentication service that supports the firm's GIS integration offering.
An open GIS application development framework is a core platform asset for a geo-IT firm like con terra, even though it has only been mentioned on the website so far.
Promoted as new with its own page in 2024 and a specific integration value proposition, the identity service is a growing product closely tied to the firm's GIS customer base.
A consulting workshop launched in 2024 with its own page is cheap to maintain and generates leads for the firm's established consulting business.
